notes: Notes you can dictate straight into the pill, a dark mode that follows the phone, and a service that is far lighter on the battery.

whatsNew.title: Notes, dictated
whatsNew.body: Start a sentence with the word “note” and the pill grows into a card instead of typing. Letting go of the key saves it. They have their own tab now, next to the settings.

whatsNew.title: Dark mode
whatsNew.body: Follows the phone, or the toggle under the name at the top of the page. Everything crossfades rather than snapping.

whatsNew.title: Much lighter on the battery
whatsNew.body: The service was subscribed to every screen change in every app on the phone and threw them all away. It no longer asks for them, and speech is transcribed over as much audio as you actually spoke instead of a fixed thirty seconds.

whatsNew.title: A page that is easier to get through
whatsNew.body: Setting up is one card, with the model picker inside it. The long explanations are behind info dots, and What's new is a dropdown.
